pages.notes:
All four figures are done. The lint command gives 0 findings. Nothing is committed.

Changes:
- New recipes in `recipes/output/post-process/`: four recipes and the shared file `_dialog.py`.
- New images in `images/output/post-process/` and four entries in `manifest.yml`.
- The page has one new sentence and one block image at the end of each of the subsections Overview, Operations, Options (after the table) and Output. The page had no old figures.

State that the recipes set by script (each is a state the user can get):
- Tool Controller: Horizontal Feed 600 mm/min, Vertical Feed 200 mm/min, Spindle Speed 12000. With the default value 0, the Time column showed "Tool Feedrate Error".
- Job Output File: `%D/%d-%j.nc`. The default is empty, and then the Filename template field is empty.
- Drilling: `findAllHoles`, the function of the Auto Select button. Without it, the Drilling Operation has no holes.
- The Output recipe presses the Generate Output button of the dialog.

Problems found:
1. Order fault in the shared helper pattern. When `save_machine()` ran before `shot.open_model()`, the log showed "Sketch: Solving the sketch failed", the Stock had zero size, and the Operation heights were 1.79e308. The G-code then had a damaged Z value. `_dialog.py` saves the Machine after the Job and the Operations exist. `recipes/output/machine-configuration/_machine.py` and its recipes use the faulty order. I did not change them. I did not find the root cause. Examine the figures `job-output-tab-machine.png` and `post-dialog-options-postprocessor-properties.png` of that page.
2. One run of the Operations capture gave an empty Time column. Three subsequent runs gave the correct values, and the final image is correct. I did not find the cause.
3. The Output figure is not the same on each run. The Output folder and the "Project File" header line show the temporary folder of the model copy (`/tmp/gypsy-model-<random>`), and the header shows the output time.
4. `dialog-options.png` shows the same state as `output/machine-configuration/post-dialog-options-postprocessor-properties.png` on the Machine Configuration page. I made a separate image for this page because the wanted file name is in the folder of this page.
5. The Warnings tab label shows "Warnings 2" in all four figures. This is the Sanity Check result for the sample Job.
6. A temporary debug recipe (`zz-debug`) was used and removed, with its image and its manifest entry.

pages.notes:
1. The page sentence about the blue arrow is not accurate. The source (src/Mod/CAM/Gui/ViewProviderPath.cpp, PathSelectionObserver) shows the arrow only while the pointer is on a move of the Toolpath. The arrow is at the pointer position and points in the direction of that move. It is not a permanent mark at the start point. The recipe sends a pointer move event to the 3D view, 3 mm after the start point on the first move. The image thus shows the arrow near the start point, not at it, and the first move has the highlight colour. The alt text says "near the start point". The sentence that I added says: "The figure shows the arrow on the first move of the Toolpath, where the pointer is." I did not change the page sentence. A person must correct it.

2. I added a test model: models/lines-arcs-1.FCStd, with an entry in models/models.json. STYLE.md §10.3 requires a model in models/ and no model had a sketch of lines and arcs. The model is one Sketch in the XY plane: three straight lines and two arcs of radius 10 mm, from (0, 0) to (40, 0). The direct FreeCADCmd call was not permitted in this session. I thus built the file with a temporary recipe through gypsy/capture.py and deleted that recipe. The build script is not in the repository.

3. The Toolpath is at Z = 1 mm, the top of the default Stock, which is the default depth of an Engrave Operation. The page text gives (0, 0, 0) as the start. The first capture and the last capture used this default depth and gave a correct image. Two captures between them had the Toolpath at Z = 0 and failed, because the pointer then selected the Stock or the sketch and no arrow showed. I went back to the default depth. The difference in Z is not visible in the figure.

4. Both recipes write the image with view.saveImage(shot.out, ...) directly. The sketch recipe does this because shot.view() always sets the isometric view and the sketch figure is about the XY plane. The Toolpath recipe calls shot.view() first, then moves the pointer and saves the image again with the arrow. A shot.view() option for a plane view and for a pointer position can remove this.

5. The sketch figure shows the Sketcher grid, which is the default with an empty profile.

6. The page has two new reference sentences and two image blocks in the Preparation section. The lint gives 0 findings. Nothing is committed. The work tree also has changes to output/post-process.adoc and its figures; those were there before this task and I did not touch them.

pages.notes:
The capture succeeded on each of three runs; runs 2 and 3 corrected the appearance (background, default-button highlight).

1. The Preferences Editor is modal, so the recipe does not open it. The recipe creates `AssetPreferencesPage` (the class that `InitGui.py` registers), calls `loadSettings()`, and shows the page in a plain `QDialog`. The image shows the page only, without the page tree and the buttons of the Preferences Editor. The page width is the minimum width of the page, which is less than the width in the Preferences Editor.

2. The recipe sets `autoDefault` to off on the buttons of the page. Without this, the plain dialog showed Reset as the default button, which the Preferences Editor does not do.

3. The recipe saves one Machine, "Shop Router", in the asset folder of the profile, so that the Machines list is not empty.

4. The Default path field shows the path of the temporary capture profile (`/tmp/gypsy-fc-<random>/CamAssets`). A user sees `CamAssets` in the user application data directory. The path is different on each run, so the image is not identical between runs. A fixed profile path in `gypsy/capture.py` would correct this; I did not change the capture tool.

5. Page change: one sentence and the block image (width 400) are added in the "Machines" section, before the list. `gypsy/lint.py --since origin/main` gives 0 findings. The page had no old figure. The manifest has the new entry.
